        $kinds = @{}
        foreach ($record in @($reportPlain.Records)) {
            Assert-True (@('File', 'Directory', 'ReparsePoint') -contains [string]$record.Kind) ('unexpected Kind ' + $record.Kind)
            if ([string]$record.Kind -eq 'ReparsePoint') {
                Assert-True (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty([string]$record.ReparseKind)) ('ReparseKind of ' + $record.RelativePath)
                $kinds[[string]$record.ReparseKind] = $true
            }
            else {
                Assert-Equal '$null' (Format-Value $record.ReparseKind) ('ReparseKind of plain entry ' + $record.RelativePath)
            }
        }
        Assert-True $kinds.ContainsKey('Junction') 'Junction present in the fixture'
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 06 three distinct root errors
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    Invoke-Check -Title '06a missing root, file root and uncanonicalisable root report three distinct codes' -Body {
        $missing = Get-WReparseReport -Root (Join-Path $fx 'does-not-exist')
        Assert-Equal 1 @($missing.Errors).Count 'missing root error count'
        Assert-Equal 'not_found' @($missing.Errors)[0].Code 'missing root code'
        Assert-Equal '.' @($missing.Errors)[0].RelativePath 'missing root RelativePath'
        Assert-Equal 0 @($missing.Records).Count 'missing root records'
        Assert-Equal (Join-Path $fx 'does-not-exist') $missing.Root 'missing root Root'

        Assert-Equal '.' @($asFile.Errors)[0].RelativePath 'file root RelativePath'

        $codes = @([string]@($missing.Errors)[0].Code, [string]@($asFile.Errors)[0].Code, [string]@($bad.Errors)[0].Code)
        Assert-Equal 3 @($codes | Select-Object -Unique).Count 'the three codes must be distinct'
        Assert-Equal 'wreparse/1.0' $missing.SchemaVersion 'a report is returned even for a bad root'

    # 07 -MaxDepth semantics
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

        $zero = ConvertTo-WReparseJson -Report (Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot -MaxDepth 0)
        $minus = ConvertTo-WReparseJson -Report (Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot -MaxDepth -1)

        foreach ($cultureName in @('en-US', 'de-DE', 'ja-JP')) {
            $culture = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::GetCultureInfo($cultureName)
            $previousDefault = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::DefaultThreadCurrentCulture
            $previousDefaultUi = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture
            $previousThread = [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture
            $previousThreadUi = [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture
            try {
                [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = $culture

                [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture = $culture

            Assert-Equal $baseline $text ('serialisation under ' + $cultureName)
            $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()

            Assert-Equal 'too_deep' $entry.Code 'error code at -MaxDepth 1'
            Assert-Equal 'Depth limit of 1 reached; not enumerating.' $entry.Message 'error message at -MaxDepth 1'
        }
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 19 path semantics samples (contract 5.1)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    Invoke-Check -Title '19a Get-WReparseCanonicalPath samples' -Body {
        Assert-Equal $outside (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path $outside) 'already canonical'
        Assert-Equal $outside (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path ($outside + '\')) 'trailing separator is stripped'
        Assert-Equal $outside (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path ($outside + '\.')) 'dot segment is collapsed'
        Assert-Equal $outside (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path ($outside + '\..\outside')) 'parent segment is collapsed'
        Assert-Equal $outside (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path ($outside.Replace('\', '/'))) 'forward slashes are normalised'
        $mixed = Join-Path $outside 'PLAIN.TXT'
        Assert-Equal $mixed (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path $mixed) 'casing is preserved verbatim for a non-existent leaf'
        Assert-Equal ($outside.ToUpperInvariant()) (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path $outside.ToUpperInvariant()) 'casing of the input is kept'
        Assert-True (-not [string]::Equals((Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path $outside), $outside.ToLowerInvariant(), [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal)) 'canonicalisation must not lower-case'
        $volume = [System.IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($outside)
        Assert-Equal $volume (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path $volume) 'volume root keeps its trailing separator'
        Assert-Equal $volume (Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path ($volume + '\')) 'volume root is stable'
        Assert-Throws { Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path 'C:\bad<>|path' } 'Get-WReparseCanonicalPath on an illegal path'
        Assert-Throws { Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path '' } 'Get-WReparseCanonicalPath on an empty path'
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 20 access denied sub directory
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    if ($denyApplied) {
        Invoke-Check -Title '20a a denied sub directory reports access_denied, the rest still scans' -Body {
            $report = Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot
            Assert-True ($null -ne (Get-ErrorEntry $report 'denied' 'access_denied')) 'access_denied must be reported for the denied directory'
            Assert-Equal 1 @($report.Errors).Count 'the denied directory is the only error'
            Assert-Equal 1 $report.Stats.Errors 'Stats.Errors'
            $deniedRecord = Get-Record $report 'denied'
            Assert-True ($null -ne $deniedRecord) 'the denied directory itself is still recorded'
            Assert-Equal 'Directory' $deniedRecord.Kind 'denied Kind'
            Assert-Equal 1 $deniedRecord.Depth 'denied Depth'
            Assert-True ($null -ne (Get-Record $report 'docs\readme.txt')) 'other branches still produce records'
            Assert-True ($null -eq (Get-Record $report 'denied\inside.txt')) 'children of the denied directory are not recorded'
            Assert-True ($null -ne (Get-ErrorEntry (Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot -Follow) 'denied' 'access_denied')) 'access_denied is reported under -Follow too'
        }
    }
    else {
        Invoke-Skip -Title '20a a denied sub directory reports access_denied, the rest still scans' -Reason 'the deny ACE could not be applied'
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 21 the scan is read only
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    Invoke-Check -Title '21a scanning does not modify the fixture' -Body {
        $before = Get-FixtureSnapshot -Root $fx
        Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot | Out-Null
        Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot -Follow | Out-Null
        Get-WReparseReport -Root $contract -Follow | Out-Null
        Get-WReparseReport -Root $deepTree | Out-Null
        Get-WReparseReport -Root $emptyTree | Out-Null
        ConvertTo-WReparseJson -Report (Get-WReparseReport -Root $scanroot) | Out-Null
        Test-WReparseWithinRoot -Path $scanroot -Root $scanroot | Out-Null
        Get-WReparseCanonicalPath -Path $scanroot | Out-Null
        $after = Get-FixtureSnapshot -Root $fx
        Assert-True ($before.Count -gt 50) 'the snapshot must not be empty'
        $differences = @(Compare-Object -ReferenceObject $before -DifferenceObject $after)
        if ($differences.Count -gt 0) {
            $shown = @($differences | Select-Object -First 4 | ForEach-Object { [string]$_.SideIndicator + ' ' + [string]$_.InputObject })
            throw ('the fixture changed during the scan: ' + ($shown -join ' | '))
        }
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 22 published empty-tree serialisation (contract 3.6)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    Invoke-Check -Title '22a serialisation of an empty tree matches contract 3.6 byte for byte' -Body {
        $json = ConvertTo-WReparseJson -Report (Get-WReparseReport -Root $emptyTree)
        $expectedLines = @(
            '{'
            '    "SchemaVersion":  "wreparse/1.0",'
            ('    "Root":  "' + ($emptyTree.Replace('\', '\\')) + '",')
            '    "Records":  [ ],'
            '    "Errors":  [ ],'
            '    "Stats":  {'
            '                  "Directories":  0,'
            '                  "Files":  0,'
            '                  "ReparsePoints":  0,'
            '                  "Skipped":  0,'
            '                  "Errors":  0'
            '              }'
            '}'
        )
        Assert-Equal ([string]::Join("`r`n", [string[]]$expectedLines)) $json 'serialised empty tree'
    }

    $exitCode = 0
}
catch {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host ('[FAIL] fixture/setup: ' + $_.Exception.Message)
    if ($_.ScriptStackTrace) { Write-Host ($_.ScriptStackTrace) }
    $script:FailCount++
    $exitCode = 1
}
finally {
    if ($denyApplied -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $icacls) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $denied)) {
        $denyIdentity = "$($env:USERDOMAIN)\$($env:USERNAME)"
        & $icacls $denied /remove:d $denyIdentity /c 2>&1 | Out-Null
        & $icacls $denied /reset /t /c 2>&1 | Out-Null
    }
    if ($script:OwnWorkRoot -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $WorkRoot)) {
        Remove-ReparsePoints -Root $WorkRoot
        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $WorkRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $WorkRoot) { & cmd.exe /c "rd /s /q `"$WorkRoot`"" 2>&1 | Out-Null }
    }
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host ('selftest: {0} passed, {1} failed, {2} skipped' -f $script:PassCount, $script:FailCount, $script:SkipCount)
if (($script:FailCount -gt 0) -or ($exitCode -ne 0)) {
    Write-Host 'selftest: FAILED'
    exit 1
}
Write-Host 'selftest: OK'
exit 0
